## Setup
```{r load-packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(rprojroot)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(SeuratObject)
library(scCustomize)
library(AUCell)
library(msigdbr)
library(pheatmap)
library(cowplot)

# Define directories
root_dir <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data", "v4")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "murine-cart-tumor")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "plots")

# Source custom theme
source(file.path(root_dir, "figures", "theme.R"))

# set random seed
set.seed(1234)
```

## Load Data
```{r load-data}
# Load Seurat object
myeloid_obj <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "cart_myeloid_subtypes.rds"))
```

```{r visualize-subcluster-markers-dotplot, fig.height=16, fig.width=8, warning=FALSE}
myeloid_subcluster_markers <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir, "myeloid_subcluster_markers.csv"))

top10_markers <- myeloid_subcluster_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(n = 10, wt = avg_log2FC)

hallmark <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = "H")

category_df <- top10_markers %>%
  inner_join(
    hallmark %>% select(gs_name, gene_symbol),
    by = c("gene" = "gene_symbol")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(category = gs_name)

category_df_clean <- category_df %>%
  distinct(gene, category, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

category_df_clean <- category_df_clean %>%
  arrange(category, gene)

# remove categories that have only one gene (don't plot these)
category_counts <- category_df_clean %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  tally(name = "n_genes")

categories_to_keep <- category_counts %>%
  filter(n_genes > 1) %>%
  pull(category)

category_df_clean <- category_df_clean %>%
  filter(category %in% categories_to_keep)

gene_order <- unique(category_df_clean$gene)

anyDuplicated(gene_order)

# ---- safer gene positions per category ----
gene_pos_df <- category_df_clean %>%
  mutate(pos = match(gene, gene_order)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pos))

category_bounds <- gene_pos_df %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarize(
    start = min(pos),
    end   = max(pos),
    mid   = (start + end) / 2,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Create category labels dataframe
category_labels <- category_bounds %>%
  mutate(category_clean = str_remove(category, "HALLMARK_"))

# ---- main dotplot (remove manual bottom margin hack) ----
p_main <- DotPlot(
  myeloid_obj,
  features = gene_order,
  cols = "RdYlBu",
  group.by = "seurat_clusters",
  assay = "RNA"
) +
  theme_Publication() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  ylab("Cluster") +
  geom_vline(
    data = category_bounds,
    aes(xintercept = end + 0.5),
    linetype = "dotted",
    color = "black",
    size = 0.4,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )

p_main <- p_main +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 80, l = 10)  # give space for gene labels
  )

# ---- bottom strip: ONLY category labels, aligned to gene positions ----
p_cat <- ggplot(category_labels, aes(x = mid, y = 1, label = category_clean)) +
  geom_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  # match DotPlot's x coordinate system (genes are 1..length(features))
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1, length(gene_order)), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(t = 30, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10)
  )

# ---- stack them: categories UNDER gene labels ----
p_final <- p_main / p_cat + plot_layout(heights = c(12, 5))

pdf(file = file.path(plot_dir, "myeloid_dotplot_subcluster_markers.pdf"),
    width = 20, height = 12)
print(p_final)
dev.off()

```

## Marker genes on treatment groups
```{r subset-treatment-markers, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
myeloid_treatment_markers <- FindAllMarkers(myeloid_obj,
                                            assay = "RNA",
                                            group.by = "condition",
                                            slot = "data",
                                            only.pos = TRUE,
                                            min.pct = 0.5,
                                            logfc.threshold = 0.5)

myeloid_treatment_markers <- myeloid_treatment_markers %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05)

write.csv(myeloid_treatment_markers, file.path(results_dir, "myeloid_treatment_markers.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Visualize top markers per treatment by dot plot
```{r visualize-treatment-markers-dotplot, fig.height=16, fig.width=8, warning=FALSE}
myeloid_treatment_markers <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir, "myeloid_treatment_markers.csv"))

category_df <- myeloid_treatment_markers %>%
  inner_join(
    hallmark %>% select(gs_name, gene_symbol),
    by = c("gene" = "gene_symbol")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(category = gs_name)

category_df_clean <- category_df %>%
  distinct(gene, category, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%   
  group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

category_df_clean <- category_df_clean %>%
  arrange(category, gene)

# remove categories that have only one gene (don't plot these)
category_counts <- category_df_clean %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  tally(name = "n_genes")

categories_to_keep <- category_counts %>%
  filter(n_genes > 1) %>%
  pull(category)

category_df_clean <- category_df_clean %>%
  filter(category %in% categories_to_keep)

gene_order <- unique(category_df_clean$gene)

anyDuplicated(gene_order)

# ---- safer gene positions per category ----
gene_pos_df <- category_df_clean %>%
  mutate(pos = match(gene, gene_order)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pos))

category_bounds <- gene_pos_df %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarize(
    start = min(pos),
    end   = max(pos),
    mid   = (start + end) / 2,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Create category labels dataframe
category_labels <- category_bounds %>%
  mutate(category_clean = str_remove(category, "HALLMARK_"))

# ---- main dotplot (remove manual bottom margin hack) ----
p_main <- DotPlot(
  myeloid_obj,
  features = gene_order,
  cols = "RdYlBu",
  group.by = "condition",
  assay = "RNA"
) +
  theme_Publication() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  ylab(NULL) +
  geom_vline(
    data = category_bounds,
    aes(xintercept = end + 0.5),
    linetype = "dotted",
    color = "black",
    size = 0.4,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )

# ---- bottom strip: ONLY category labels, aligned to gene positions ----
p_cat <- ggplot(category_labels, aes(x = mid, y = 1, label = category_clean)) +
  geom_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  # match DotPlot's x coordinate system (genes are 1..length(features))
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1, length(gene_order)), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10)
  )

# ---- stack them: categories UNDER gene labels ----
p_final <- p_main / p_cat + plot_layout(heights = c(12, 5))

pdf(file = file.path(plot_dir, "myeloid_dotplot_treatment_markers.pdf"),
    width = 18, height = 12)
print(p_final)
dev.off()
```
